transaction.gdn_prepare: all 48 candidate layer states in one reusable alternate workspace buffer
transaction.gdn_publish: two host pointer swaps after successful output and KV commit
transaction.attention_prepare: one candidate key row and value row for each of 16 attention layers
transaction.attention_publish: copy candidate rows at the uncommitted frontier, synchronize, then publish the frontier
transaction.logical_kv_state: rows strictly below the committed frontier

interruption.interface: caller status poll after a synchronized layer boundary
interruption.invariant: a non-ok poll status returns without publishing candidate state

sampling.implemented_gate: greedy argmax over session-owned committed FP32 logits
